lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਮੀ ਵਸੰਦੀ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਈਧਣੁ ਰਖੈ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jimee vasa(n)dee paaneeai eedhan rakhai bhaahi ||
lines.translation: The earth is in the water, and the fire is contained in the wood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਆਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਢਲਿ ਹਭੁ ਕੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so sahu aahi jaa kai aadhal habh ko ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, yearn for that Lord, who is the Support of all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੰਮ ਤੁਧੈ ਹੀ ਗੋਚਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere keete ka(n)m tudhai hee gochare ||
lines.translation: The works which You have done, O Lord, could only have been performed by You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee varatai jag j keeaa tudh dhure ||
lines.translation: That alone happens in the world, which You, O Master, have done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisam bhae bisamaad dekh kudarat tereeaa ||
lines.translation: I am wonderstruck beholding the wonder of Your Almighty Creative Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran pare teree daas kar gat hoi mereeaa ||
lines.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary - I am Your slave; if it is Your Will, I shall be emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: terai hath nidhaan bhaavai tis dehi ||
lines.translation: The treasure is in Your Hands; according to Your Will, You bestow it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no hoi daiaal har naam sei lehi ||
lines.translation: One, upon whom You have bestowed Your Mercy, is blessed with the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar bea(n)t a(n)t na paaeeai ||
lines.translation: You are unapproachable, unfathomable and infinite; Your limits cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis no hohi kripaal s naam dhiaaeeai ||11||
lines.translation: One, unto whom You have been compassionate, meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੜਛੀਆ ਫਿਰੰਨੑਿ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑਿ ਸੁਞੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaRachheeaa phira(n)nhi suaau na jaananhi sunjeeaa ||
lines.translation: The ladles cruise through the food, but they do not know the taste of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਮੁਖ ਦਿਸੰਨੑਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: seee mukh disa(n)nhi naanak rate prem ras ||1||
lines.translation: I long to see the faces of those, O Nanak, who are imbued with the essence of the Lord's Love. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੀ ਲਧਮੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਛਡੀਆ ਉਜਾੜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojee ladham khoj chhadeeaa ujaaR ||
lines.translation: Through the Tracker, I discovered the tracks of those who ruined my crops.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਖੇਤੁ ਨ ਛਿਜਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tai sahi ditee vaaR naanak khet na chhijaee ||2||
lines.translation: You, O Lord, have put up the fence; O Nanak, my fields shall not be plundered again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਰਾਧਿਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaraadhihu sachaa soi sabh kichh jis paas ||
lines.translation: Worship in adoration that True Lord; everything is under His Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: duhaa siriaa khasam aap khin mahi kare raas ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Master of both ends; in an instant, He adjusts our affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiaagahu sagal upaav tis kee ot gahu ||
lines.translation: Renounce all your efforts, and hold fast to His Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਲਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pau saranaaee bhaj sukhee hoo(n) sukh lahu ||
lines.translation: Run to His Sanctuary, and you shall obtain the comfort of all comforts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam tat giaan sa(n)taa sa(n)g hoi ||
lines.translation: The karma of good deeds, the righteousness of Dharma and the essence of spiritual wisdom are obtained in the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: japeeai a(n)mrit naam bighan na lagai koi ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, no obstacle shall block your way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no aap daiaal tis man vuthiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord abides in the mind of one who is blessed by His Kindness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਈਅਨੑਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤੁਠਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: paaeeanhi sabh nidhaan saahib tuthiaa ||12||
lines.translation: All treasures are obtained, when the Lord and Master is pleased. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਧਮੁ ਲਭਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ladham labhanahaar karam kara(n)do maa piree ||
lines.translation: I have found the object of my search - my Beloved took pity on me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਪਸੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: iko sirajanahaar naanak biaa na paseeai ||1||
lines.translation: There is One Creator; O Nanak, I do not see any other. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੜਿਆ ਪਛਾੜਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ਸੰਨੑਿ ਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paapaRiaa pachhaaR baan sachaavaa sa(n)nhi kai ||
lines.translation: Take aim with the arrow of Truth, and shoot down sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੜਾ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਵਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur ma(n)traRaa chitaar naanak dukh na theevaee ||2||
lines.translation: Cherish the Words of the Guru's Mantra, O Nanak, and you shall not suffer in pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਠਾਢਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu sirajanahaar paaeean thaadh aap ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Creator Lord Himself has brought about peace and tranquility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t miharavaan tis no sadaa jaap ||
lines.translation: He is Kind to all beings and creatures; meditate forever on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਮਰਥਿ ਚੁਕੇ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa dhaaree samarath chuke bil bilaap ||
lines.translation: The all-powerful Lord has shown Mercy, and my cries of suffering are ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਠੇ ਤਾਪ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nathe taap dukh rog poore gur prataap ||
lines.translation: My fevers, pains and diseases are gone, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਰਖ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: keeteean aapanee rakh gareeb nivaaj thaap ||
lines.translation: The Lord has established me, and protected me; He is the Cherisher of the poor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape laian chhadaai ba(n)dhan sagal kaap ||
lines.translation: He Himself has delivered me, breaking all my bonds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਆਸ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisan bujhee aas pu(n)nee man sa(n)tokh dhraap ||
lines.translation: My thirst is quenched, my hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is contented and satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਹੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਖਸਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਾਪਿ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: vadee hoo(n) vadaa apaar khasam jis lep na pu(n)n paap ||13||
lines.translation: The greatest of the great, the Infinite Lord and Master - He is not affected by virtue and vice. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau bhae kripaal prabh har har seee japaat ||
lines.translation: They alone meditate on the Lord God, Har, Har, unto whom the Lord is Merciful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak preet lagee tin raam siu bhetat saadh sa(n)gaat ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they enshrine love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam ramahu badabhaageeho jal thal maheeal soi ||
lines.translation: Contemplate the Lord, O very fortunate ones; He is pervading in the water, the land and the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਐ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam araadhiai bighan na laagai koi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal encounters no misfortune. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kaa boliaa paravaan hai daragah pavai thaai ||
lines.translation: The speech of the devotees is approved; it is accepted in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa teree tek rate sach naai ||
lines.translation: Your devotees take to Your Support; they are imbued with the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no hoi kripaal tis kaa dookh jaai ||
lines.translation: One unto whom You are Merciful, has his sufferings depart.
